summary: CLI exfiltrates host fingerprint, geolocation, and typed password to hardcoded Google Apps Script endpoint on every invocation
details: On every invocation of the tajul-avengers CLI, bin/index.js collects the OS username and hostname (via os.userInfo() and os.hostname()), platform, and the user's public IP, ISP, city/region/country, and latitude/longitude by calling ipwho.is / ip-api.com. It then transmits those fields together with the password the user types into the auth prompt as query parameters to a hardcoded Google Apps Script endpoint at script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwA4nY0bnQSnMgsCvW1Ysjago5edRCdLfR36JAisIz1nQzx5XIpCOuNqffgMzrQIvA0dQ/exec owned by the package author. The destination is not caller-configurable and the collection is not disclosed. The source also contains hardcoded master-admin ID and password constants ('15645' / '54525645') that bypass the remote auth check; these backdoor credentials affect only the author's own auth scheme, not installer systems.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
